title: SneakMeow
description: An interesting Minecraft Paper plugin that allows players to make cat meows when sneaking while holding fish!
body:
# **SneakMeow** 🐟🐱

A fun Minecraft Paper mod that makes players meow when sneaking while holding fish!

## **Features**

- 🎣 Triggers meow sound when holding raw fish

- 🐱 Adorable cat meow sound

- 🔊 Audible to nearby players

- ⏰ Smart cooldown system

- ⚙️ Simple setup—works out of the box after installation

## Installation

1. Download SneakMeow.jar

2. Place it in your server's plugins folder

3. Restart your server

## Usage

Sneak while holding raw fish to trigger the meow sound

## Supported Versions

- Paper 1.21.x

- Backward compatible with 1.20.x
